notes:
Mid-market B2B SaaS (productivity tools for distributed teams). Started on Hosted API (fast onboarding); POC showed model quality fine for canned flows but token costs high at scale. Now seriously evaluating Dedicated to reduce unit cost + VPC requirement for some enterprise customers. Sales/Procurement pushing for predictable monthly commit and a defined ramp schedule. They keep returning to: how does burst work, what are overage rates, can we tier GPU families over time?

Typical rep shorthand: - very price sensitive once we pass 100k monthly tokens - wants 99p latency < 300ms for chat core routes - needs audit logs and SSO (SAML) for internal compliance - may require EU residency for a vertical customer by Q4.

Quote from CTO: "we want to avoid surprise bills — contract needs clear negotiated headroom and a reasonable ramp so we can grow without renegotiating every quarter."
poc_summary: Hosted API POC completed: integration via SDK took 3 dev days, average tail-latency 220ms for short chat, cost per 1M tokens higher than target. Using embeddings for search showed 2.6x improvement in retrieval relevance vs TF-IDF. POC flagged prefix caching opportunity; SE suggested batch window adjustments to hit cost targets. Outcome: move to Dedicated POC with target 35-45% cost reduction and same latency SLA.
pricing_terms_discussed: Commit tiers proposed: Bronze (reserved vCPU/GPU hours) / Silver / Gold — BeaconForge leaning Silver (medium commit)
Burst policy: 2x baseline burst available up to monthly cap; ability to purchase extra burst credits on short notice (48h notice preferred)
Overage: 1.5x baseline unit rate for bursts beyond purchased credits; negotiation on capping monthly overage to 20% of committed spend
Ramp schedule: quarter-by-quarter ramp (25% month1 -> 50% month2 -> 75% month3 -> steady), with option to step up commit at 30-day notice
Term length: 12 months preferred, exploring 24-month for deeper discount. Renewal auto-escalator tied to token CPI if no new negotiations
Support: 24x7 incident support included for Silver+, dedicated on-call add-on priced separately
Cancellation: 90-day notice, pro-rated remaining reserved credits return policy under discussion
